g.text: §5 RELATED WORKS
Prior work is organized by output type; contracts differ in editability, and VLMscores are mostly used for evaluation, not as release gates
Representative systems per output type, what they emit, and the contract each leaves open (§5.1–5.5)

Paper-to-poster

Paper2Poster (PosterAgent, benchmark, PaperQuiz) [1]; PosterGen (specializedagents incl. color and typography) [2]; P2P (HTML poster, fine-grained benchmark) [3];PosterForest [28]; EfficientPosterGen [29]; APEX (edits PPTX) [30]; SciPostLayout /SciPostGen [31, 32]; Any2Poster [33]; PosterHarness [34]
Paper2Poster and PosterGen emitPPTX; APEX edits PPTX; P2Prenders HTML
VLM scores serve evaluation rather thanruntime release gates; no shared upstreamasset bundle across artifacts
Slides and video

PPSGen [37] → D2S [38] → DOC2PPT [39] → SlideSpawn [40] → PPTAgent [41],SlideGen [42]; PresentAgent [26, 27]; VideoAgent (Manim, duration, style) [5];Paper2Video / PaperTalker (101-paper benchmark, cursor grounding, talking head) [4];Preacher [6]; AutoLectures [43]

Blog and long-form
HERA [8]; PTSPI [9]; GoSum [10]; LongDPO [44]; ProjectMundo (JATS-preservingtranslation) [45]; lay-summary accessibility studies [46]; Papers-to-Posts (interactivereverse source outline) [7]
Summaries, translations, oneresearch blog piece from an outline
Editable Word output with layout-awarechecks, for a paired Chinese and Englisharticle
Multi-artifact suites

PaperX (Scholar DAG → PPT, poster, public-relations posts) [11]; OmniPresent(concurrent: poster, slide, and video suites from one HTML representation withcross-modal verify-and-repair) [12], discussed qualitatively
Several formats from onerepresentation
Native-editable source per artifact andexperience-level convergence into oneinteractive viewer

"Rather than claiming the first multi-artifact generator, ResearchStudio-Reel focuses on a native-editable, section-aligned dissemination workspace."(§5.5) The distinction it draws is native editability plus experience-level convergence, backed by release checks.
WHAT THE PAPER IS SCORED AGAINST IN TABLE 1 (§3)
Single-shot frontier LLMs
Claude-4.8 Opus, GPT-5.5, Gemini-3.1 Pro — one fixedprompt, one call, a whole A0 poster as HTML (Appendix G)
Reproduced poster pipelines
Paper2Poster tool, P2P, PosterGen under their releasedconfigurations, scored by the same pipeline
Human reference
The authors' own posters for the 100 benchmark papers;OmniPresent is discussed qualitatively, not scored
Source: arXiv:2607.04438 v2 (19 Jul 2026)
